'''Nefra''', formally referred to as '''Nefra, Who Bars the Way''' was an [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemically]]-modified [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[underwalker]] created by [[Dread Masters|Dread Master]] [[Brontes]]. Nefra was tasked with guarding the gate to the [[Dread Fortress]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Oricon]], and was [[Death/Legends|slain]] by invading forces during the [[Dread War]].<ref name="Dread" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nefra, Who Bars the Way appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' as the first boss in Operation: Dread Fortress, which was added in Game Update 2.4. Like other Operation bosses, Nefra is featured in trophies in the Digital Expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]''.<ref name="Dread" />
